title: Binary classification measures for random approximate sets
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 7. Distributions, expectations, and variances of binary classification measures (PPV, NPV, accuracy, F1, Youden's J) for the Bernoulli set model, via standard delta-method expansions validated by Monte Carlo; no novelty is claimed for the technique.
